title: Tim Olaore (healthcare and leadership) on Incorruptible: 'really stretching my perspective'
summary: Olaore works in healthcare and leadership. Writing from chapter 11, he picked out how intentional companies have to be about governance structures that protect ethos and mission, and likened the book's Devoted Health examples to AdventHealth's service standards.
blockquote: I am on chapter 11 of Incorruptible and it’s really stretching my perspective on what anchors an organization to withstand economic gravitational forces.
